default.notes: A visitor visa is issued on arrival at Amata Kabua International Airport in Majuro for 30 days, extendable at the Division of Immigration, against a passport valid six months, a confirmed onward ticket, accommodation details and a fee of about USD 50 in cash.

groups.notes: Citizens of the other freely associated Micronesian states are admitted without a visa under long-standing reciprocal arrangements — carry a passport and complete the arrival card as usual.
Visa-free for 30 days under the Marshall Islands exemption list, extendable at the Division of Immigration in Majuro; an onward ticket and accommodation details are still required on arrival.

MH.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Marshallese citizens.

US.notes: Under the Compact of Free Association, US citizens may enter, live and work in the Marshall Islands with no visa and no time limit — a valid passport and the arrival card are still required.
